# Lithium → Sodium Periodic Comparison

| Variable               | Li               | Na                    |
| ---------------------- | ---------------- | --------------------- |
| outer configuration    | 2s¹              | 3s¹                   |
| common charge          | +1               | +1                    |
| shell                  | n=2              | n=3                   |
| ionic size             | smaller          | larger                |
| graphite compatibility | strong Li system | different Na behavior |
| hard-carbon role       | secondary        | central Na-ion anode  |
